public_rationale: The engineering evidence supports the mechanism that longer reasoning consumes more resources. It does not settle whether January R1 operation was expensive under a specified workload. The direct cost disclosure concerns February and combines V3 with R1; lower API prices measure a different quantity. An unknown accounting basis also prevents a supported or contradicted money assessment.
limitations: The claim has a meaningful ordinary reading, but its cost level remains unmeasured.
A large deployment's daily expense alone does not establish high cost per useful answer.
Later serving optimizations cannot automatically be attributed to the January release period.
